events.title: 📺 Sia is live — Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Sia is hanging out on the desktop all fest long. Grab the free demo and bring her to your own desktop!

events.title: Demo update — calmer battles and a smoother first 10 minutes
events.summary: Welcome, everyone joining from Steam Next Fest! This update polishes battle and your first 10 minutes with Sia. ⚔ Battle is much quieter. In the first 10 minutes, speech bubbles went from 126 to 34. Regular floors now show a floating "▶ 12" instead of a line, and Sia comments on kills far less often. The first 🔷 skill point tip was instantly covered by other lines and never seen. New records, new areas and boss rules now come together in one bubble. ⏩ Auto Advance trial: for your first 15 floors

events.title: Demo update — battle has no ceiling anymore
events.summary: ⚔ Battle has no end now. Past floor 4300, monsters stopped getting stronger, and from around floor 4500 battle could freeze. Numbers now keep growing as high as you can climb. Fixed: lag in battle around floor 4000. Battle skill window: maxed skills fold into one row, so the window no longer stretches to the bottom of the screen. Buttons respond reliably, and closing the window no longer leaves hidden copies running in the background. The rebirth hint in the shop showed the attack multiplier as

events.title: Demo update — sound is back, and Sia has a voice
events.summary: 🔊 Sound effects are back. We pulled them earlier because some were far too loud — every sound has now been re-leveled so nothing jumps out at you. Volume is in Settings. 🗣 Sia now has a voice: short reactions (Korean exclamations) when you pick her up, throw her, pet her or make her dizzy. It's an occasional reaction, not voice acting — her lines are still text. You can turn just the voice off in Settings with "🗣 Sia's voice". events.summary: New in battle: 👁 every 100th floor, an Entity shows up instead of the boss. It's tougher than any boss and keeps vanishing and reappearing. New battle buddy: 📺 TCHIKA. Once every skill is maxed, spend 🔷 on TCHIKA's Support, Attack and Ranged skills. events.summary: New: 🍎 macOS support (macOS 11 or later). Install the demo from Steam on your Mac — Sia lives in the menu bar at the top of the screen. events.title: Demo update — stream window for OBS & multi-monitor fixes
events.summary: New: 📺 Stream window (OBS). Open it from the tray menu or Settings → General. In OBS, add a Window Capture of "Sia - OBS" plus a Chroma Key filter, and only Sia shows up on stream — no desktop, no notifications. Right-click it to switch the background between green, blue and magenta. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46254569/deb9fcf6d034fa4efc2e0a2b31fc26a5b00ac056.png Fixed: Sia on a second monitor coming back on the main one after a restart, or after that monitor went to sleep. events.title: Demo update — tarot, new yandere tricks & more to spend gems on
events.summary: Tarot and the Lucky Box are now in the demo — your gems finally have somewhere to go. What you unlock carries over to the full game. The demo now sells every speech bubble theme (8 new ones) and the Studio up to Lv.3. The Studio also gets battle upgrades: Light Stick and Merch. Knife throwing comes in new styles: a three-knife fan, knife rain, a heart around your cursor, and a boomerang. Six new things yandere Sia does on her own, from sharpening knives to "loves me, loves me not". Screen cracks

events.title: Demo update — throw her to the sky, window size, no more sound effects
events.summary: Throw her hard and she flies off the top of the screen, then falls back down. A bubble at the top shows where she is and how high. Throws feel heavier — no more floating like she's on the moon. A little dust cloud puffs up when she lands. New option: window size (70–100%). It shrinks Sia's windows only — Sia and her bubbles stay the same size. The home panel has a compact view (toggle in its header). On short screens it starts compact. events.title: Demo update — Sia's new look & an easier first day
events.summary: Sia has a new look All of Sia's art is replaced with a new chibi style — every pose, in normal and yandere mode. The angel outfit and the battle monsters got new art too. She moves more like she's alive: a wobbly walk that speeds up and slows down, breathing while she rests, and a little bounce in her idle poses. Pick her up and she dangles from the spot you grabbed. events.title: Demo Update — Let's fight together
events.summary: The demo just got an update! Only ~2 MB, and Steam installs it for me. Let's fight together ⚔ Hits feel like hits now. Big hits show big numbers, and bosses have their own HP bar. Clear a bunch in a row and I'll count them for you! Rebirth shows you the numbers before you do it. All twelve upgrades have pictures now. I'm right here 🖥 I can stay on top of fullscreen apps now. Turn it on in Settings... I want to see you. I don't hide for screenshots either. Take one of me! There's a "Window color"
